title: Very Disappointed in the Deadpool box.
text: The Deadpool box was advertised as a $50 value. Sure, the Funko was neat, but that plus the taco truck, key chain, and luggage tag together were not worth the $30 cost of the box. I purchased it thinking I would at least get a shirt or a mug, but was left feeling like I way overpaid for what would probably be a $12 Funko otherwise.
label: negative
